item.title: Show HN: Uncracked City, detective game where you question LLM suspects that lie
item.description: To give you some context on the project. I'm a solo founder and I use AI heavily in my work. The idea came from wanting players to discover cities. Each city has its own history, so every case is set in a real city with real public place | why kept: model, free
